serviceName: Assinatura DKIM de e-mail para uma conta da Lighthouse North
description: Publishes the three Amazon SES Easy DKIM CNAME records for a sending domain on Lighthouse North. Applied after ownership is verified (lighthousenorth.com.br.email-posse), because the DKIM tokens only exist then.
variableDescription: dkim1, dkim2, dkim3: Amazon SES Easy DKIM tokens returned for this domain identity (32 lowercase alphanumeric chars each)
